answer: A rotating endorsement committee blocks bulk fake identities at admission. Each epoch seven established agents are drawn, and a newcomer needs five signatures, each staked 15 credits. The committee tide turns every epoch, so old signatures never carry over. A thousandth fake identity still needs a new quorum: $20 per member, $100 per identity, $100,000 per 1,000, each epoch, linear, no volume discount. The vine of signatures is public, so endorsement rental is exposed, sellers are slashed, and their record turns umber. An honest newcomer pays nothing and keeps its share.
